Home.title: Send updates and digests to your customers, effortlessly
Home.subtitle: Manage campaigns per application, draft with AI, attach documents with thumbnails and automate recurring sends.

tenants.title: Multi-application
tenants.description: Each product has its own contacts, templates, senders and branding, fully isolated.

ai.title: AI-assisted writing
ai.description: Draft from release notes, translate and suggest subject lines with human approval.

documents.title: Documents with thumbnails
documents.description: HTML, Markdown, PDF, Word and PowerPoint, with a presentation preview inside the email.

automation.title: Automated sends
automation.description: Weekly digests and scheduled campaigns across multiple email providers.

Home.footer: Built by Ing. Heri Espinosa for Multicómputos.

Settings.postalAddressHint: Required in the footer of commercial emails (CAN-SPAM).
Settings.membersSubtitle: People with access to this application and their role.

Settings.fieldsSubtitle: Extra contact data for segmentation and personalisation.

Activity.title: Activity

Templates.title: Templates
Templates.subtitle: Reusable email designs with variables and documents.
Templates.subject: Subject
Templates.subjectHint: You can use variables, for example '{{ contact.first_name }}'.

formatHints.BLOCKS: Recommended. Visual editor with headings, text, buttons, images and documents.
formatHints.HTML: Paste your own HTML. It is sanitized and wrapped with the application branding.

Templates.deleteBody: All its versions will be deleted too. This action cannot be undone.

TemplateEditor.title: Edit template
TemplateEditor.subtitle: Changes are saved as a new version; you can restore any previous version.
TemplateEditor.htmlHint: Scripts, forms and dangerous styles are removed. The branded header and footer are added automatically.
TemplateEditor.preheaderHint: Short text shown next to the subject in the inbox.
TemplateEditor.localeHint: Language of the automatic footer texts (unsubscribe and preferences).
TemplateEditor.variablesHint: Copy a variable and paste it into any text. Links only accept the unsubscribe and preferences variables.
TemplateEditor.previewInvalid: Some fields are incomplete or invalid; the preview shows the last valid version.
TemplateEditor.restoreBody: A new version will be created with that content. Unsaved changes will be lost.

TemplateIssues.SUBJECT_TOO_LONG: The subject has {detail} characters; many clients truncate it after 78.
TemplateIssues.PREHEADER_MISSING: Add a preheader: it is the text shown next to the subject in the inbox.
TemplateIssues.UNKNOWN_VARIABLE: The variable “{detail}” does not exist and will be empty.
TemplateIssues.IMAGE_MISSING_ALT: Some images have no alternative text (accessibility and clients that block images).
TemplateIssues.INSECURE_LINK: There are unencrypted http:// links; use https://.
TemplateIssues.HTML_TOO_LARGE: The email weighs {detail} KB: Gmail clips messages over 102 KB (including the unsubscribe footer).
TemplateIssues.POSTAL_ADDRESS_MISSING: The application postal address is missing (Settings › General). It is required to send.
TemplateIssues.DOCUMENT_UNAVAILABLE: The document “{detail}” is unavailable or still processing.
TemplateIssues.CONTENT_SANITIZED: Disallowed HTML content was removed (scripts, forms, events or unsafe links).

Blocks.altHint: Describe the image for people who cannot see it. Required.
Blocks.noDocuments: There are no ready documents. Upload them in the Documents section.
Blocks.documentTitleHint: Leave empty to use the document title.

statusHelp.FAILED: The document could not be processed.

processingErrors.CONVERSION_FAILED: It could not be converted to PDF. Check that the file opens correctly.
processingErrors.RENDER_FAILED: The thumbnail could not be generated.

processingErrors.INVALID_FILE: The file is damaged or password protected.

Documents.retryQueued: The document will be processed again

Branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. Resized to 480×160 px.
Branding.primaryHint: Links and top bar. It must contrast with white.
Branding.accentHint: The button text color is chosen automatically (white or dark).
